title: For Loop over Collection
concept: A for loop can iterate directly over collections like Vec, processing each element one at a time.
why: Most real data comes in collections — lists of users, scores, or items. For loops let you process them all elegantly.
tips: `for item in collection` is the cleanest way to process every element
The loop variable is immutable — you can't modify the collection through it
Vecs hold elements of the SAME type: `[1, 2, 3]` not `[1, "two", 3.0]`
You'll learn much more about Vec in Level 2!
common_mistakes: Trying to mix types in a Vec: `[1, "hello"]` — all elements must be same type
Thinking the loop variable is an index — it's the element value itself
Modifying a Vec while iterating over it (advanced topic for later)
